subject: Stakeholder map & MAP: FinPay discovery follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Johnston <sara.johnston@finpay.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Stakeholder map + MAP (post-call recap)

Hi Sara — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary of today
- Goal: Reduce inference cost and lock latency SLOs for FinPay's customer chat assistant.
- Current blockers: procurement needs SOC2 evidence; security team will request data retention and KMS details; unclear who the economic buyer is.
- Decision criteria you mentioned: latency <= 150ms p95; predictable monthly spend; audit logs retained for 12 months.

Proposed immediate next steps
1) Stakeholder map: please confirm names/emails for security, procurement, and the economic buyer so we can build the MAP.
2) I'll share a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestones (security review, procurement RFP, pilot start).
3) I'll include SOC2 summary + reference architecture for your security team.

Tentative timeline (we discussed):
- Week of 5/17: Security review kickoff
- Week of 5/24: Procurement redlines / SOW negotiation
- Week of 6/7: Pilot begins (2-week pilot)

Attachments: I will attach a draft MAP and SOC2 summary in my next email.

Ask: Can you confirm the economic buyer and procurement contact by EOD Thursday (5/13)? If it helps, I can loop in procurement directly.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning the plan.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0193

From: Sara Johnston <sara.johnston@finpay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@finpay.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stakeholder map + MAP (post-call recap)

Thanks Marissa — really helpful recap. Quick answers: 

- Economic buyer: Tom Lee (CPO) — tom.lee@finpay.com (cc'd).
- Procurement: procurement@finpay.com (we'll add an individual once we open the SOW).
- Security: Sara Johnston (me) leads the security intake; I'll bring in the cloud security lead (TBD) once you send the SOC2 summary and architecture.

Timeline looks right to me. One note from Tom (copied): we need an initial cost estimate for a 2-week pilot (approx 5M tokens/month) before procurement will open a ticket. Can you include that in the MAP?

I'll aim to confirm the named procurement contact by 5/13. Please send the MAP + SOC2 summary when ready.

-Sara

Head of Security | FinPay

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Stakeholder map + MAP (post-call recap) — internal notes

Internal — forwarding Sara's reply and Tom's cc. Quick notes for ops and pricing: 

1) Cost estimate: need pilot pricing for ~5M tokens/month (2-week pilot scaled to monthly), include option for Dedicated reserved capacity vs hosted run-rate. Rishi, can you draft ASAP? Tom wants to see this in the MAP.
2) Security pack: attach SOC2-summary (short) + reference arch diagram. Dylan, please confirm the KMS/HSM and audit log retention details we should include.
3) MAP milestones: I'll draft a 6-item MAP (security review kickoff, procurement SOW, legal redlines, pilot start, pilot eval, decision date). Target decision date: 6/21.

I'll take the initial MAP draft and send to them tomorrow with attachments.

Thanks — Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Johnston <sara.johnston@finpay.com>, Tom Lee <tom.lee@finpay.com>, FinPay Procurement <procurement@finpay.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan (MAP) + pilot cost estimate — FinPay (FP-2026-042)

Hi Sara / Tom — attaching the first-pass MAP and SOC2 summary per our discussion. Highlights below and ask at the end.

MAP highlights (attached spreadsheet):
- Milestone 1 (by 5/20): Security review kickoff — Redwood to provide SOC2 summary, reference arch, KMS/HSM details, and sample audit logs.
- Milestone 2 (by 5/27): Procurement opens SOW & pricing review — FinPay to provide procurement contact; Redwood to provide SOW template and pilot pricing.
- Milestone 3 (by 6/7): Pilot start (2 weeks) — scope: 5M tokens/month equivalent; success criteria: latency p95 <= 150ms and throughput meeting X reqs.
- Milestone 4 (by 6/21): Pilot evaluation and go/no-go decision.

Pilot cost estimate (hosted, non-dedicated)
- Estimated token consumption: 5,000,000 tokens/month equivalent (pilot scaled to monthly)
- Estimated run-rate: $2,250/month (est) — this is a host-rate estimate; dedicated reserved capacity pricing is available and typically requires a 3-month commit.

Attachments included:
- FinPay - Mutual Action Plan v1.xlsx (Milestones + owners + dates + acceptance criteria)
- SOC2-summary.pdf (controls summary and audit authority contact)

Ask: Can you confirm procurement contact and confirm security reviewer availability for the week of 5/17? If we get confirmation, we'll schedule a 30-minute intake call and share the detailed security packet.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
